subject: Nordica: routing & custody questions for EU/UK transfers
messages:
From: Elin Berg <elin.berg@nordicahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nordica Legal <legal@nordicahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data transfer model and baseline asks

Hi Ben,

Quick follow-up from our security intake: Nordica is mapping how Redwood would be used in our product pipeline and we have three narrow questions before we proceed to procurement: 

1) For EU-origin data, do you operate under Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) by default for hosted customers, or do you require the UK IDTA / UK addendum for UK-origin data? We need the exact docs we can attach to our DPA.

2) For our use case (PII tokenization + short text enrichment), are there specific processing locations or caching behaviors we should be aware of (e.g., transient US cache, edge fallback)? We have a residency requirement for EU processing except for ephemeral caching under 12 hours.

3) Who are your subprocessors for storage and logging (we'll need a CSV/attestation for procurement)? Any HSM/KMS custody variations for Dedicated/Private deployments?

Can you point us to the minimal evidence pack (SCC mapping, UK addendum status, subprocessor list) we can share with our legal ops team?

Thanks,
Elin
Legal Ops 
Nordica Health

---

P.S. We may need an estimate of signing cadence (DocuSign) and an abbreviated TIA scope if you have a template.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2025 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Data transfer model and baseline asks (Nordica)

Ben — quick notes below, attaching a compact evidence pack. See attachments: SCCs-Mapping-v3.xlsx (mapping of SCC clause to our processing flows), UK-IDTA-annotated.docx (status + redlines), TIA-scope-notes.pdf (short template).

Answers: 
- Hosted customers: we provide SCCs as the primary transfer mechanism for EU transfers. For UK-origin data we support the UK IDTA/UK addendum; the addendum is available but for hosted contracts we typically apply the UK addendum when the customer requests it or when procurement flags it. The annotated doc includes the language we add and a recommended clause for the DPA.

- Caching: Our runtime may perform transient KV caching in regional nodes to support low latency. We classify ephemeral cache < 24 hours. For customers who require <12h residency we can propose a configuration: restrict cache to EU-only region + reduce TTL to 4h. That configuration is available for Dedicated and Private; for Hosted we can often accommodate on a best-effort configuration (we'll need ops sign-off).

- Subprocessors: see subprocessor CSV tab in the XLSX. Primary storage/logging: GCP (europe-west1) for EU customers by default, S3-equivalent for fallbacks; logging uses a separate logging pipeline (third-party logging provider) — we've annotated which subprocessors have access to PII. For HSM/KMS: Dedicated/Private support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM); Hosted supports Redwood-managed KMS but we offer BYOK for Dedicated.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Ben: send Nordica the attached pack and ask them to confirm if they need UK addendum applied contractually or only as evidence.
2) If Nordica insists on strict <12h cache within Hosted, we'll need a short ops design (Kim).
3) Legal to prepare the drafting language for DPA + DocuSign cadence (I can review).

I'll be available for a 30-min sync Monday afternoon if needed.

Laura Bennett
Head of Privacy & Legal
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: SCCs-Mapping-v3.xlsx, UK-IDTA-annotated.docx, TIA-scope-notes.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elin Berg <elin.berg@nordicahealth.com>
Cc: Nordica Legal <legal@nordicahealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Nov 2025 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data transfer model and baseline asks — evidence pack and proposed next steps

Hi Elin — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a compact evidence pack (SCCs mapping, annotated UK IDTA, and a short TIA skeleton) that Laura prepared. High-level answers inline below then next steps.

Inline: 
- SCCs / UK addendum: SCCs are our default for EU transfers. We can and will include the UK IDTA addendum for any contract that needs UK-origin coverage; please confirm whether you want the addendum applied by default or only as an attachment to the DPA.

- Residency / caching: Our platform may have ephemeral caching for performance, but we can propose an EU-only cache TTL of 4 hours for Hosted if you require tighter residency. For Dedicated/Private we can guarantee EU-only processing and customer-managed KMS.

- Subprocessors & custody: please see the XLSX tab labeled "subprocessors"; it lists which subprocessors touch logs, storage, and telemetry. For Hosted customers the KMS is Redwood-managed; for Dedicated/Private we offer BYOK/HSM.

Requested next steps: 
1) Please confirm whether Nordica requires the UK addendum to be contractually applied or if evidence is sufficient for procurement.
2) If you require the <12h cache limitation in Hosted, let us know and we'll spin up an ops proposal and timeline (estimate 2-3 business days for a feasibility note).
3) If procurement is happy with the evidence pack, we can open a DocuSign for the DPA next week — estimated signing cadence 5-7 business days.

If you'd like, set a 30-min call and I can viably include Laura/Kim — otherwise Laura will continue the redline conversation via email.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
